summary: A Material Symbols icon (4,157 icons, outlined, rounded or sharp, plain or filled) drawn as a vector path, tinted with one colour. Use it for every symbol on screen instead of a text glyph or emoji.

name.doc: The icon's Material Symbols name, e.g. wifi, home, settings, battery_charging_full, arrow_upward. Search with find kind "icons" (by name, tag or category)

style.doc: The icon family's style; keep one style across a screen

filled.doc: The filled variant: for a selected or active state (a selected tab, a liked heart)

size.doc: Size in dp (icons are designed at 24; 20 to 48 work well)

color.doc: Tint; a theme colour keeps light, dark and mono right

label.doc: Accessibility label. Give one when the icon means something on its own (a status, an icon-only button); leave it out when a text next to it says the same

pitfalls: Icons replace text glyphs and emoji (◐ ★ ☀ ✓): those render differently per font, can't take theme colours and are usually only approximations
The name must exist: an unknown name fails with the closest matches; search by meaning with find kind "icons" (tags such as 'battery', 'signal', 'weather')
Each icon's path is stored once per document however many times it is called; different icons each add about 0.5 to 2 KB
autoMirrored icons (arrows, back) are not flipped for right-to-left layouts
